quotations.old_english: Ic wát eardfæstne ánne standan, deáfne dumban, sé oft swilged gifrum láicum
quotations.english: the subject of the riddle is a bookcase, the gifre lác are books
quotations.citations: Rä. 50, 3. 7u In Rä 270 a book is the subject.

source_text: gifre. Add :-- Ic w&a-long;t eardfæstne &a-long;nne standan, deáfne dumban, s&e-long; oft swilged gifrum l&a-long;cum (the subject of the riddle is a bookcase, the gifre l&a-long;c are books), Rä. 50, 3. 7u In Rä 270 a book is the subject.
